name: Dodgeball!
desc:
🔴 Dodgeball! 
⚡ 12 Player Dodgeball. Can you be the last one standing? 
FFA: Dash to the center and grab the dodgeball! But if are holding the ball when the timer hits 0, you die!
Teams: Dash to the center and fight in an intense battle against the other team!

🔥 BE FAST: Race to grab the ball. 
🎯 HIT UR SHOTS: If you don't hit someone in time, you die!
✨ LEVEL UP: Gain Cash to get exclusive ball skins.

🏆 Can you survive the battle and be the last one standing?

CONTROLS:
DASH - Q / Lb
THROW - Left Click / Tap Screen / rt
CROUCH - C/ Button B/Button O
